title: Cyclodextrin/caffeic acid nanofibers with enhanced antioxidant activity, fast-release and fast-disintegrating properties
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6FB00056H, Paper
Open Access

Asli Celebioglu, Kubra Ertan, Mahmoud Aboelkheir, Tamer Uyar
Cyclodextrin (CD) inclusion complex (IC) nanofibers containing caffeic acid were fabricated via electrospinning. The orally fast-disintegrating nanofibers showed fast-release and enhanced antioxidant properties for nutraceutical delivery.
